name: CI checks on every push
needs: run my tests automatically before I deploy
stop broken code from reaching main
my AI agent keeps breaking things that used to work
set up GitHub Actions for my app
summary: An automatic run of your tests, linters, type checks and build on every push or pull request. A red result blocks the merge or deploy, so a change that breaks something is caught in minutes instead of by users.
need_when: You have any tests, or you ship code written by AI agents and want a safety net.
skip_when: Never once there's a second contributor, human or AI.

ways.title: GitHub Actions
ways.cost: free for public repos, monthly free minutes for private
ways.how: A workflow file runs on push and pull_request: install, lint, type check, test, build. Mark it required in branch protection.
ways.tradeoff: Built into GitHub. Private repo minutes run out on heavy suites.

ways.title: Your host's or Git provider's CI
ways.how: GitLab CI, Bitbucket Pipelines, CircleCI, or build checks on Vercel, Netlify and Render.
ways.tradeoff: Fine choices. Pick the one next to your code.

ways.title: A local release script
ways.how: One script you (and your agents) run before each deploy that runs every check and refuses to continue on failure.
ways.tradeoff: Free and fast on your machine. Only works if it can't be skipped.

prompt:
Set up CI that runs on every push and pull request.

Requirements:
- Steps in order: install from lockfile, lint, type check, unit tests, migrations check ([no missing migrations]), build, then [a short end-to-end smoke test].
- Use a real database service of the same version as production for tests, not SQLite if production is Postgres.
- Cache dependencies. Target under [10] minutes.
- Add a dependency audit step that fails on high severity.
- Make the workflow required for merging into main.
- Fail on warnings that hide real bugs (unawaited promises, unused imports) once the code is clean.
- Show me how to run the exact same checks locally with one command.

Acceptance checks (run each and show me the result):
1. A pull request with a failing test can't be merged.
2. The local command and CI run the same steps.
3. A model change without a migration fails CI.
4. CI runs against the same database engine as production.
5. A typical run finishes in under 10 minutes.
acceptance_checks: A pull request with a failing test can't be merged.
The local command and CI run the same steps.
A model change without a migration fails CI.
CI runs against the same database engine as production.
A typical run finishes in under 10 minutes.
if_you_skip_it: Bugs that tests would have caught reach production, and nobody knows which change caused them.
how_derek_runs_it: Custody Journal uses a free local release gate script rather than hosted CI. It runs ruff, Django checks, a missing-migrations check, a migration cycle test, the full test suite, pip-audit, npm audit, a Postgres concurrency test, a Playwright smoke test and a Docker build, and it fails closed.
